baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative turning in يُقَلِّبُ joins the opposed pair ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ to عِبْرَة and أَبْصَار.
baseline_models.mechanism: God repeatedly turns two opposed temporal and visual conditions from one face to the other. Ocular comparison encounters the difference, and inward sight converts that recurring reversal into admonitory understanding.

activation_trace.role: Returning a thing from one face to another supplies the repeated state-change operator.
Night as the opposite of day and as darkness supplies one visible pole.
Day opening in light supplies the opposed visible pole.
Taking one observed condition as a lesson for another supplies the stated purpose.
Ocular seeing supplies sensory access to the alternation.
Inner discernment supplies the reception by which seeing becomes a lesson.

changed_reading.before: God alternates night and day, and the cycle is an observable sign.
changed_reading.after: The recurring reversal is itself an exercise in comparison: visible difference is meant to be carried into admonitory insight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun عِبْرَة stands between the turned visible pair and the qualified أُولِي ٱلْأَبْصَار.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch field of ع ب ر makes the lesson a passage rather than a label. Sight begins with the surface sequence, then crosses from what appears into what the sequence means, as one moves from a dream's exterior to its interpretation.

activation_trace.role: Passing from one side to another supplies the cognitive transit.
Moving from a dream's surface to its meaning models interpretation beyond appearance.
Turning the viewed object through opposed faces creates the material for interpretation.
Penetrating knowledge supplies the destination of the crossing.

changed_reading.before: The alternation contains a generic lesson for perceptive people.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a disciplined crossing from a sensible sequence to its governing significance; eyesight starts the movement but does not complete it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier context performs two human-scale reversals of judgment: what is reckoned evil is called beneficial good, and what is reckoned slight is great with God. These paired corrections transfer the focus turning from a merely astronomical cycle to the overturning of premature evaluations; عِبْرَة becomes learned reclassification.

activation_trace.role: Turning something away from its presented face supplies the focus mechanism for revised valuation.
Comparing one case with another supplies the act of learning from corrected judgments.
Suppositional reckoning marks the initial estimate that the clause overturns.
Evil and harm supply the first assigned value.
Beneficial good supplies the corrected value.
A second act of supposition supplies the repeated error pattern.
Ease and lightness supply the underestimated scale.
Greatness and force supply the corrected scale.

structural_cues: 24:11 places the evil/good correction inside one reckoning frame.
24:15 repeats the same reckoning frame with a slight/great correction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit corrections of ح س ب; I assign their evaluative reversal as a human analogue of God's ق ل ب in 24:44. A live alternative is that they only exemplify bad judgment and do not specify the natural sign.

changed_reading.before: Night and day reverse as an external natural fact.
changed_reading.after: Their reversal trains the beholder to let apparently fixed moral and social estimates be turned toward a truer scale.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah treats sight as an aperture that must be deliberately lowered and that a flash can nearly remove. Thus أُولِي ٱلْأَبْصَار are not simply people equipped with eyes: they are stewards of a vulnerable faculty whose exposure, intensity, and direction affect whether it yields عِبْرَة.

activation_trace.role: The faculty of ocular sight supplies the focus instrument under contextual pressure.
Insight supplies the possible achievement of a properly governed faculty.
Restraint by lowering and diminishing supplies active modulation of seeing.
The commanded object is the same ocular faculty named in the focus.
Lightning's flash supplies an intensity that can overwhelm rather than inform.
Going away supplies the threatened removal of sight.
The same ocular faculty appears as vulnerable to seizure by excessive light.

structural_cues: 24:30-31 repeat the command to lower sights before 24:44 names possessors of sights.
24:43 ends immediately before the focus with lightning nearly taking sights away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commanded lowering and threatened removal of the same faculty; I infer that 'possessing sights' entails governing a contingent capacity. Alternatively, the legal and meteorological uses may remain separate applications.

changed_reading.before: People with functioning eyes can notice the temporal cycle.
changed_reading.after: The qualified beholder manages a vulnerable faculty, neither feeding it indiscriminately nor mistaking sensory intensity for insight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context makes visual appearance unreliable on its own: light enables disclosure, a mirage shines like water, coverings layer over the field, and even one's hand can become barely visible. The interpretive branch of عِبْرَة is therefore necessary: perception must cross from appearance to truth under enabling illumination.

activation_trace.role: Translation from a presented surface to its meaning supplies the corrective operation.
Penetrating inner knowledge supplies the perceptual result beyond raw appearance.
Repeated illumination supplies the positive condition under which things become disclosed.
A mirage gleaming like water supplies a visually persuasive false surface.
A covering that rises over and conceals supplies layered obstruction.
Eye-and-insight seeing supplies the nearly failed act of recognizing one's own hand.
The denied illumination identifies what the obscured field lacks.

structural_cues: 24:39 moves from apparent water to finding nothing at the point of encounter.
24:40 stacks obstructions and makes even the near hand barely visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enabled, deceptive, and covered visual fields; I infer that عِبْرَة names the passage that corrects appearance. A live alternative is that the examples concern distinct moral populations rather than a general account of perception.

changed_reading.before: The day-night cycle is self-evident to anyone who looks.
changed_reading.after: The cycle becomes a lesson only when illuminated discernment carries the observer beyond appearances that can also deceive or disappear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus roots are coupled earlier in a coming day when hearts and sights turn. The focus then externalizes that instability into the regularly turned night and day. Cosmic alternation becomes a visible rehearsal for a human turnover in which the inner center and the seeing organ both lose their settled orientation.

activation_trace.role: Turning from one face or direction to another supplies the cosmic operation.
The ocular faculty supplies the audience and one member of the contextual echo.
The repeated root's turning branch supplies the destabilizing action on that day.
The same occurrence cluster's heart branch supplies the inner human center being turned.
The ocular faculty is explicitly paired with hearts as undergoing turnover.

structural_cues: 24:37 places ق ل ب and ب ص ر in one clause governed by a feared day.
24:44 reunites the same roots while making night and day the object of turning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact root echo and a shift from turned hearts/sights to turned night/day; I infer a rehearsal relation from the regular cosmic event to the coming human event. The live alternative is lexical resonance without typological direction.

changed_reading.before: The ayah invites calm reflection on a stable natural rhythm.
changed_reading.after: The stable rhythm teaches through repeated instability: each outward turnover anticipates a day when the observer's own heart and sight will be turned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sits between two process chains. Clouds are driven, joined, heaped, and made to release rain; then creatures are originated from one water and differentiated into modes of movement. Between them, يُقَلِّبُ reads as a compact process signature: divine agency moves material through ordered configurations rather than merely swapping two labels.

activation_trace.role: Gentle driving supplies the first directed stage in the cloud sequence.
Joining one thing to another supplies ordered assembly.
Accumulation layer over layer supplies a changed material configuration.
Descending rain supplies the emergent output of the assembled cloud.
Turning a thing through faces supplies the hinge's general transformation operator.
Originating creation supplies agency for the second process chain.
Water supplies the shared material starting point.
Repeated movement supplies the divergent embodied outputs.

structural_cues: 24:44 is bracketed by 24:43's assembly-to-rain sequence and 24:45's one-water-to-many-gaits sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two adjacent ordered transformations; I infer that the intervening ق ل ب states their shared process grammar. Alternatively, the three ayat may simply list independent signs under common agency.

changed_reading.before: Night and day are two states exchanged in a binary cycle.
changed_reading.after: Their turnover is the middle instance of a wider material grammar in which directed stages assemble, emerge, and diversify.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later household rules convert the day-night cycle into access thresholds: permission is required around dawn, midday undressing, and the night prayer because those transitions expose concealed states. The cosmic alternation therefore also produces an ethical clock governing when bodies and rooms may be crossed into.

activation_trace.role: Night supplies one temporal boundary later used to regulate access.
Daylight supplies the opposed temporal field containing the midday boundary.
Crossing from side to side supplies the access-threshold image.
Permission and authorization supply the rule governing passage.
Dawn breaking out of night supplies the first transition boundary.
The appointed time of a thing supplies explicit temporal differentiation.
Garment and covering supply the exposed or concealed bodily state.
The evening and night-prayer time supplies the final daily boundary.
The concealed private state supplies the reason access changes with time.

structural_cues: 24:58 names three recurring times and calls them three private exposures.
The three times cluster around emergence from night, midday disrobing, and return to night.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies timed permission around exposed states; I infer that the night-day turning in 24:44 generates ethical access boundaries. A live alternative is that 24:58 uses the cycle only as a practical clock without feeding back into the focus lesson.

changed_reading.before: Night and day are large-scale objects of contemplation.
changed_reading.after: Their transitions enter the household as recurring boundaries that teach when seeing and crossing into another's space are permitted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets a later legal inclusion pressure the focus audience rather than glossing the focus phrase directly. It remains anchored in ب ص ر's own eye/insight split and in 24:61's pairing of bodily blindness with a final appeal to عقل; downstream prose should present it as evidence that physical eyesight is insufficient, not as a claim that the focus denies its literal visual sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أُولِي ٱلْأَبْصَار can activate both the ocular and inward-discernment branches of ب ص ر.

activation_trace.role: Physical eyesight supplies the obvious but contextually insufficient qualification.
Insight of the heart supplies a non-ocular mode of receiving the lesson.
Loss of physical sight supplies the included countercase.
Intellect restraining ignorance supplies the verse's final reception faculty.

changed_reading.before: Those with eyesight form the audience able to see the sign.
changed_reading.after: The relevant possession is sight converted into discernment; the later inclusion of the physically blind and appeal to intellect destabilize eyesight as a sufficient criterion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it leans on the packet's split mapping of ء و ل to و ل ي rather than the ordinary possessive force of أُولِي. It remains anchored in the focus word, the supplied succession branch, and contextual و ل ي occurrences of turning away; downstream prose should label it packet-licensed wordplay about sustained attention, never a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus form أُولِي has a supplied و ل ي target beside أَبْصَار, allowing a secondary succession/attendance activation.

activation_trace.role: Close succession of one thing after another supplies sustained attendance to the alternating phases.
Inner discernment supplies what sustained attendance is meant to produce.
Turning away supplies the first contextual opposite of attentive succession.
Repeated turning away supplies a second contrast with remaining near the signs.

changed_reading.before: Possessors of sight name a static class.
changed_reading.after: As a contained sound/root activation, they are those whose seeing stays in sequence with the signs instead of turning away when a sign demands response.

strongest_changes: The exact ق ل ب and ب ص ر echo in 24:37 turns natural alternation into a rehearsal for the turnover of hearts and sights.
The illuminated, deceptive, covered, lowered, and nearly removed visual fields make عِبْرَة an achieved interpretation rather than automatic eyesight.
The bracketing process chains and the later privacy times extend night-day turnover into material transformation and ethically differentiated access.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made 24:44 a hinge: earlier human judgments and hearts are turned, its immediate neighbors stage ordered material transformations, and later rules convert temporal transitions into boundaries around exposure.
remaining_uncertainties: The 24:37 root echo may establish intentional rehearsal, or it may remain thematic resonance without a directional relation.
The privacy-clock transfer may be a governing implication of 24:44 or only an exploratory downstream application.
The ء و ل to و ل ي activation is packet-licensed but form-distant and must remain secondary.
